app.title: TAC-timesheet
app.subtitle: Japan dispatch, expatriate, and client-site timesheet management
dashboard.employees_desc: Employee master records available for timesheet input.
dashboard.status_desc: TAC-timesheet uses TAC-employeeadmin as the employee master when available, with local fallback for offline use.
timesheet.table_notice: Filter by employee, month, customer, project, or approval status for statistics and billing.
timesheet.form_notice: Choose an active employee from TAC-employeeadmin when available. Selected master data is copied into this timesheet row for audit and reporting.
timesheet.no_employee_notice: No employee records are available. You can still enter an employee number in fallback mode.
employee.title: Employees
employee.source_employeeadmin: Employee master is managed in TAC-employeeadmin. This page shows read-only employees used by Timesheet.
employee.source_local: TAC-employeeadmin is unavailable, so Timesheet is using local fallback employee records.
employee.local_notice: Local employee records are fallback/offline data only when EmployeeAdmin integration is active.
message.employeeadmin_unavailable: TAC-employeeadmin is unavailable. Using local employee fallback records.
message.employeeadmin_empty: TAC-employeeadmin returned no selectable employees. Using local fallback records if available.
employee.managed_in_employeeadmin: Employee master is managed in TAC-employeeadmin. Timesheet only reads employee data for time entry.
dashboard.organization_desc: Entities / Departments / Teams in the local organization master.
organization.title: Organization Master
organization.notice: Maintain the three-level organization structure used by Timesheet: entity, department, and team.
organization.entities_desc: Legal entities available for organization assignment.
organization.no_structure: No organization structure has been saved yet. Create an entity first, then departments and teams.
organization.no_departments: No active departments under this entity.
organization.no_teams: No active teams under this department.
entity.title: Entities
entity.notice: Maintain legal entities for the organization master.
entity.form_notice: Entity records are the top level of the three-level organization structure.
department.title: Departments
department.notice: Maintain departments under each legal entity.
department.form_notice: Department records must belong to an active legal entity.
team.title: Teams
team.notice: Maintain teams under departments for the third level of organization master data.
team.form_notice: Team records must belong to an active department under the selected entity.
timesheet.no_organization_summary: No monthly organization summary data yet.
clock_entry.title: My Clock Entry
clock_entry.notice: Choose a current-month or previous-month unlocked date, then enter only start time, end time, and break minutes. Dispatch customer/project is resolved automatically when EmployeeAdmin has a matching assignment.
clock_entry.dispatch_auto_notice: A matching dispatch assignment was found for this date and employee.
clock_entry.no_assignment_notice: No dispatch assignment was found for this date. Customer/project will remain blank for HR/Admin adjustment if needed.
clock_entry.employee_unresolved: Your User_admin account is not linked to an EmployeeAdmin employee. Please ask HR/Admin to link your account before using mobile clock entry.
clock_entry.readonly_status: This entry has already been submitted or approved and cannot be changed here.
clock_entry.readonly_locked: This month is locked and cannot be changed.
clock_entry.calculation_after_save: Calculated work time will appear after saving.
my_timesheet.title: My Monthly Timesheet
my_timesheet.missing_notice: Weekdays are estimated Monday-Friday; Japan public holidays are not deducted yet. Click a date to input it.
my_timesheet.no_missing: No missing weekday entries were found for this month.
my_timesheet.no_records: No timesheet records for this month yet.
clock_entry.outside_edit_window: Employees can maintain only current-month and previous-month unlocked records.
timesheet.assistance_notice: Use this area when Admin, HR, Finance, or a manager enters an attendance sheet received by email or from an offsite employee. Proxy entry is allowed only for open accounting periods.
timesheet.assistance_note_placeholder: Optional note, e.g. employee submitted attendance by email while offsite.
clock_entry.proxy_employee_notice: Admin/HR/Finance users can select an employee and assist with entry.
clock_entry.proxy_notice: For Admin/HR/Finance assisted clock entry, select the employee and record the assistance source/reason.
clock_entry.proxy_edit_window_notice: Proxy entry can use any open accounting period.
clock_entry.proxy_permission_required: Only Admin/HR/Finance users can select another employee.
message.entity_scope_active: 当前界面仅显示并允许操作当前法人实体的数据。
message.entity_scope_required: 请先在 Portal/User_admin 选择法人实体后再进入 Timesheet。
message.entity_scope_denied: 该记录不属于当前法人实体。请回 Portal 切换法人后再操作。
message.legacy_unassigned_hidden: 未分配法人的历史记录已从当前法人视图中隐藏，等待后续迁移。
